NodeGroupId.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，替换为NodeGroupIds参数
NodeGroupId.title: 节点组ID。

NodeGroupIds.description_en: The IDs of the node groups to select

NodeGroupName.description_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use `NodeGroupNames` instead
NodeGroupName.title: 节点组名称。

NodeGroupNames.description_en: The names of the node groups to select
NodeGroupNames.title: 节点组名称数组

NodeGroupTypes.description_zh: 节点组类型。当NodeSelectType取值NodeGroup，且参数NodeGroupId为空时生效。数组元数个数N取值范围：0~10

items.description_en:
The node group type. Valid values:

`MASTER`: The master node group.

`CORE`: The core node group.

`TASK`: The task node group
items.description_zh:
节点组类型。取值范围：
MASTER：主节点组类型。
CORE：核心节点组类型。
TASK：计算阶节点组类型

NodeGroupTypes.title: 节点组类型。

NodeNames.description_en: The names of the nodes to select. This parameter applies only when `NodeSelectType` is set to `NODE`
NodeNames.description_zh: 节点名称列表。当NodeSelectType取值Node时，该参数生效
NodeNames.title: 节点名称数组。

NodeSelectType.description_en:
The node selection type. Valid values:

`CLUSTER`: Selects all nodes in the cluster.

`NODE_GROUP`: Selects nodes by their node group.

`NODE`: Selects specific nodes by name
NodeSelectType.description_zh:
节点选择类型。取值范围：
CLUSTER：集群。
NODE_GROUP：节点组。
NODE：节点
NodeSelectType.title: 节点选择类型。

description_en: Queries the bootstrap or normal scripts of an EMR cluster
description_zh: 查询EMR集群引导脚本或普通脚本
kebab_example: aliyun emr list-scripts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --script-type BOOTSTRAP --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListScripts

parameters.help_en: The token that marks the position from which to start reading
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cluster script. Valid values:

BOOTSTRAP: a bootstrap script.

NORMAL: a normal cluster script
parameters.help_zh:
集群脚本类型。取值范围：

BOOTSTRAP：引导脚本。
NORMAL：普通集群脚本
parameters.name: script_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the cluster script. This parameter is valid only for NORMAL scripts and supports fuzzy search
parameters.help_zh: 集群脚本名称，仅限NORMAL脚本，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: script_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster script. This parameter is valid only for NORMAL scripts
parameters.name: script_id

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned in the request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_en: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh: 返回读取到的数据位置
NextToken.title_en: 返回读取到的数据位置。
NextToken.title_zh: 返回读取到的数据位置。

EndTime.description_en: The time when the execution ended. This parameter is returned only when ScriptType is set to NORMAL
EndTime.description_zh: 结束执行时间。只有当ScriptType取值为NORMAL，才有该返回值

ExecutionFailStrategy.description_en:
The policy used to handle an execution failure. Valid values:

FAILED_CONTINUE: Continue the execution.

FAILED_BLOCK: Block the execution
ExecutionFailStrategy.description_zh:
执行失败策略。取值范围：

FAILED_CONTINUE：失败后继续执行。
FAILED_BLOCK：失败后阻塞

ExecutionMoment.description_en:
The time to execute the script. Valid values:

BEFORE_INSTALL: before application installation.

AFTER_STARTED: after application startup
ExecutionMoment.description_zh:
执行时机。取值范围：

BEFORE_INSTALL：应用安装之前。
AFTER_STARTED： 应用启动后

ExecutionState.description_en:
The execution status of the script. This parameter is returned only when `ScriptType` is set to `NORMAL`. Valid values:

SCRIPT_COMPLETED: The script is successfully executed.

SCRIPT_SUBMISSION_FAILED: The script fails to be executed.

SCRIPT_RUNNING: The script is being executed
ExecutionState.description_zh:
脚本执行的状态，只有当`ScriptType`取值为`NORMAL`，才有该返回值 。取值范围：

SCRIPT_COMPLETED：脚本执行成功。
SCRIPT_SUBMISSION_FAILED：脚本执行失败。
SCRIPT_RUNNING：脚本执行中

LastUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the script was last updated

ScriptArgs.description_en: The runtime parameters of the script

StartTime.description_en: The time when the execution started. This parameter is returned only when ScriptType is set to NORMAL
StartTime.description_zh: 开始执行时间。只有当ScriptType取值为NORMAL，才有该返回值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the request conditions
